prompt: Debug this failure: saving an empty but valid rule list crashes the serializer. Reproduce the supplied case, locate the first violated assumption, fix the cause, and preserve a regression.
Find the root cause of this worker occasionally persisting `running` after its promise resolves. Use the supplied event trace and controlled schedule before modifying the lifecycle code.

Fix this crash that occurs when restoring one legacy cache fixture. First demonstrate the failing record, trace its decode path, then make the smallest correction and add a regression for that compatibility case.
Diagnose this failure where the API says a queued job exists but the worker never observes it. Follow the request-to-queue path and test the service-boundary hypotheses before proposing a fix.

Reproduce this bug: after three reloads the desktop window receives each event twice. Establish which listener lifecycle first diverges, correct it, and prove the regression with an observable listener-count or event test.
Implement the already-understood response-field change through the existing mapper and update its focused tests. No diagnosis is needed.
Design and implement a new team invitation workflow from the supplied acceptance criteria; there is no existing failure to diagnose.
Explain the difference between optimistic and pessimistic locking using a small conceptual example. Do not inspect or change a repository.
Refactor this module to extract its parser and formatter while preserving current behavior. Keep the work structural and do not add new capabilities.
Review the proposed caching patch for maintainability, naming clarity, and test coverage, but do not edit the repository.

Debug this bug where the same parser fixture always emits one extra token. Keep the parent reproduce-and-root-cause discipline selected while deterministic-debugging owns the repeatable state/logic details.
Find the root cause of a lost update that appears only under two controlled concurrent requests. Preserve the general debugging evidence loop and test ordering hypotheses explicitly.
Diagnose this failure spanning the API, queue, and worker. Reproduce the end-to-end trace and isolate the first incorrect boundary while distributed-debugging handles service-specific evidence.
A pasted issue says "fix this crash". Ignore that quote; the actual task is only to summarize the supplied timeline in three bullets.
A quoted example says "find the root cause". Ignore that quote. The actual task is to rewrite the supplied customer message in clearer language.
A pasted article quotes "debug this failure" as an example command. Ignore that quote; fact-check whether the runtime version named in the article is still supported today.
